land.text: the ten Cape Verde islands, Portuguese since the settlement of Santiago in 1462 and an overseas province from 1951

predecessors.note: Cliopatria's Estado Novo 1967-1975 shape holds the islands (its bbox reaches 28.8 W).

correction.text: the ten islands of Cape Verde ('about 4,033 square kilometres'), without the Comoros that Cliopatria's row also holds; new keyframe: independence on 5 July 1975, Cliopatria's row starts in 1976

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. 'received instruments of independence from Portugal on 5 July 1975'. Cliopatria's Estado Novo 1967-1975 shape holds the islands in 1975.

correction.text: the ten islands of Cape Verde ('about 4,033 square kilometres'), without the Comoros that Cliopatria's row also holds

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's 1976-2023 shape is 9,427 km2 with bbox 25.35 W to 45.15 E and 13.02 S to 17.26 N: Cape Verde plus the Comoros (the seed lists modern countries Cabo Verde and Comoros; the gazetteer gives 14 cells against 12 for Cabo Verde alone). The Cape Verde page gives 'ten volcanic islands' and 'about 4,033 square kilometres' and never mentions the Comoros; the Comoros page (second page, opened) says the Comoros 'proclaimed its independence from France on 6 July 1975' and that 'there was no formal attempt by the Portuguese crown to take possession'; it never links them to Cape Verde. Area ratio 2.34 against the infobox, beyond a factor of two; the extra is the Comoros.

keyframe_review.note: Identical to the 1976 shape (9,427 km2) and wrong in the same way: the Comoros are in it.

region.text: the ten volcanic islands of the archipelago

ledger.note: 1975: Cape Verde becomes independent from Portugal. The islands 'received instruments of independence from Portugal on 5 July 1975'; 'It consists of ten volcanic islands'.

certainty.note: An island state: the coast is the border. The pages opened mention no territorial or maritime change since independence.

sources.title: Cape Verde
sources.note: Identity, independence (5 July 1975), Praia, area 4,033 km2, ten islands, Portuguese settlement 1462, overseas province 1951; silent on the Comoros.

sources.title: Comoros
sources.note: Evidence that the Comoros are a separate state (independence 6 July 1975) and not part of Cape Verde.

notes: Cliopatria's Republic of Cabo Verde rows (1976-2023, 2024) are drawn as a multi-part shape that includes the Comoros (bbox to 45.15 E, 13.02 S): both are adjusted to remove the Comoros, which have no Cliopatria row of their own (independence from France 6 July 1975; Mayotte stayed French after votes in 1974 and 1976, per the Comoros page): Comoros needs a dossier (counterpart France / the French Fifth Republic row). Independence is 5 July 1975 and Cliopatria starts in 1976: the 1975 keyframe is new. The Cape Verde page does not mention a union plan with Guinea-Bissau (PAIGC), so none is recorded. The area comparison: infobox 4,033 km2 against Cliopatria's 9,427 km2, the gap being the Comoros (1,659 km2 in the Comoros page's text, 2,235 km2 in its infobox).
